mina: Heads-up — trying an experimental int3 quant workflow when converting Llama->Mistral. After packing the weights we see subtle rotary phase drift: generate outputs insert an extra '(' after long identifiers and small BLEU drop on code eval. anyone run int3 packaging with mixed-endian GPUs?
hao: int3 huh. what's the packer doing for bitstride? and which pack layout (blockwise vs interleaved)?
mina: packer=our-packer, layout=blockwise-32, stride=LSB-first. conversion call:
```
lm-convert --src llama-7b.safetensors --tgt mistral-7b.safetensors --headmap auto
pack-tool pack --model mistral-7b.safetensors --quant int3 --pack-layout blockwise-32 --endian lsb
```
ml-bot: quick eval summary:
- float32: BLEU_code=36.4
- int3(pack-lsb): BLEU_code=32.8, symptom-rate=0.9% (extra paren / identifier splits)
- int4(pack-msb): BLEU_code=35.9
(evidence id: t-2026-58)
eva: interesting that int4 ok but int3 fails. suggests packing algorithm's bitshift arithmetic misaligned for non-byte-aligned dtypes. can you dump first 128 bytes of packed attention kernel blob and compare expected bit-order?
sam: also check rotary table application: if head_dim*rotary_freq is not divisible by packing granularity the bit offset for KV tokens could shift at stride boundaries. add small assert in runtime: verify first 64 rotary indices match unquantized apply for a short prefix.
mina: pasted diff of first packed block (hex) and expected (trimmed):
```
EXPECTED: ... 0a cb 11 7f 9e ...
PACKED:   ... 0a bc 11 7f 9e ...
```
jorge: that single nibble swap looks exactly like an endian/bit-rotation bug in the packer for int3 LSB mode. propose: (1) add a packer unit test for odd-bit widths, (2) run a conversion with `--pack-endian msb` to see if it mirrors symptoms, (3) preserve float rotary tables until packer fixed (`--preserve-rotary`).
mina: quick try: repacked with `--endian msb` gives BLEU_code=35.7 and symptoms drop to 0.1% on 1k run. preserving rotary also gets us 35.8. will add unit test and open PR to fix bit-shift ordering in packer.
ml-bot: labels added: `quant-experimental`, `pack-endian-bug`, `priority-medium`. assigned to @mina and @jorge.
eva: follow-ups: add CI fuzz for packer across bit widths {2,3,4,5,6} and pack layouts; runtime assert for rotary-index equality on warmup prefix; doc note about avoiding int3 in production until fixed.
mina: thanks — patch branch `fix/pack-int3-order-9101` incoming. I'll run full 10k eval after packer tests land.
